name: Fundo de Investimento Imobiliario - FII BTG Pactual Corporate Office Fund
summary: Fundo de Investimento Imobiliário - FII BTG Pactual Corporate Office Fund is a real estate investment trust co-launched by BTG Pactual Serviços Financeiros and BTG Pactual Gestora de Recursos Ltda. The fund is managed by BTG Pactual Serviços Financeiros. The fund invests in the real estate markets of Brazil. It was formerly known as Fundo De Investimento Imobiliario Brazilian Capital Real Estate Fund. Fundo de Investimento Imobiliário - FII BTG Pactual Corporate Office Fund is domiciled in Brazil.
